other_conditions: Applicant must belong to the Minority community.
Applicant should have passed at least 10+2, Intermediate, ITI, Polytechnic Diploma, or equivalent.
Business unit must be a proprietorship or partnership firm.
Women belonging to the minority community may choose between this scheme and Mukhyamantri Mahila Udyami Yojana.
benefits_summary: Up to ₹10,00,000 financial assistance, with 50% provided as a non‑repayable grant and 50% as an interest‑free loan, plus mandatory skill‑development training.
